subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about scaling paid subscriptions for {Brand} on top of the organic curve you already own. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the first paid subscription, read natively through your web pixel and server-to-server, so we bid toward signups that convert to paid at a trial-to-paid of 30% instead of free accounts that never activate. That is the quality bar Writesonic and Rytr watch in a partner. If it helps, I can share the trial-to-paid view this week. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate first-paid-subscription optimization proof
